newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Yeltsin signs Gazprom decree - Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Yeltsin signs Gazprom decree - Interfax.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin has signed a decree on gas monopoly Gazprom to strengthen the government's control over the firm, Interfax news agency quoted a Kremlin source as saying on Monday.
The proposed decree was presented to Yeltsin by First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov on Monday, Interfax said.
The presidential press service could not immediately confirm the Interfax report.
Nemtsov said earlier on Monday that the decree envisages setting up a committee of government representatives in the company and changing the management of 35 percent of shares in the firm.

Nemtsov, who is in charge of revamping natural monopolies -- large companies with no competitors -- said last month that he was working on an agreement on how to manage the government's share in Gazprom.
The state has a 40 percent stake, seven-eights of which are personally managed in trust by Gazprom chairman Rem Vyakhirev.
